metric_names: Maxabs IQ<=1e-5, relative total-loss error<=1e-5, relative L2 all-G and conditional-mean-input gradient errors<=1e-4; relative posterior residual<=1e-8.
Both original source global and source other-RX prior; seven scenes,32 rows each,14 cells. All physical and prior branches/F0 source objective included in forward/backward.
One matched numerical/warmup pair, then three timed pairs with alternating order. Actual shared GPU forward/backward/total seconds and allocated peak memory.
Strict final G/F0 state unchanged, zero optimizer/TX/V/OE/target. No classification accuracy or full-epoch speedup claim.
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: No target predictions; aggregate source-output/loss/gradient differences only.
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: No true TX scoring. Independently verify all14 cells, fixed tolerances, state checks and cost arithmetic.

rows.purpose: Falsify numerical/gradient equivalence and measure actual source microbatch compute cost before any integration.
rows.seed_notes: Frozen source G20; deterministic source quotas and matched per-cell dropout RNG, original R07 draw1.
rows.scenario: Source-only7 scenes ×2 prior contexts,32 rows/cell; no Main or target.
rows.budget_ref: 224 unique legal source rows;14 cells;2 solvers ×(one numerical/warmup+3 timing) full source forward/backward calls per cell;0 optimizer updates.

notes: Write C_y=Q+BKK^TB^T where Q=C-BB^T is strictly SPD under the existing stored mode margin. Factor AQA^T+noiseI without gradients; only a64x64 factor carries covariance-head gradients.
